ops.title: FP enablement UX: detect user-disabled extension + guide the System Settings toggle
ops.description: Live finding (2026-07-03 FP rollout): pluginkit -e use election shows '+' and passes FileProviderAvailable, but fileproviderd keeps the provider '⏹ user-disabled' (fileproviderctl dump) until the user flips System Settings ▸ General ▸ Login Items & Extensions ▸ File Providers ▸ CCPoolStatus. No public API/CLI can flip it (consent-gated by design). Symptom: domain add + getUserVisibleURL succeed, enumeration times out (NSCocoaErrorDomain 256), appex never spawns, probe returns register-failed (transient) forever — never retreats, never self-heals. Follow-ups: (a) doctor: when the extension is elected but the probe times out with no appex process, print the deep link open "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.LoginItems-Settings.extension" + toggle instructions (extend fusekit Backend.Enablement() text too); (b) host app: when start() rehydrates pending domains while the provider is user-disabled, prompt once with a button opening that pane; (c) spike ExtensionKit EXAppExtensionBrowserViewController for in-app enablement UI; (d) prefer behavioral detection over parsing fileproviderctl dump (private format).

ops.text: ccp doctor prints the System Settings deep link + toggle guidance when the FP extension is enabled in pluginkit but fileproviderd has it user-disabled
CCPoolStatus host app surfaces a one-click path to the File Providers settings pane when domains are pending on a user-disabled provider
